metadata.title: $\widetilde{H}$-cobordisms, infinite cyclic covers, and real Seiberg--Witten theory
metadata.abstract: We study $\widetilde{H}$-cobordisms of distinguished homology handles, introduced by Kawauchi in 1976 using infinite cyclic covers. Despite the extensive development of gauge-theoretic and Floer-theoretic invariants since Kawauchi's work, none were previously known to distinguish smooth and topological $\widetilde{H}$-cobordism. In this paper, we construct asymptotic invariants of distinguished homology handles by applying real Seiberg--Witten theory to finite cyclic covers. Using these invariants, we show that the kernel of the natural map from the smooth $\widetilde{H}$-cobordism group to its topological counterpart contains a subgroup isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}$. We also define spin versions of these groups and show that the kernel of the corresponding natural map contains a subgroup isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}^\infty$.

analysis.workSummary: 对有标记同调 handle 的 H-tilde 配边构造渐近不变量，区分光滑与拓扑配边，并在自旋版本的自然映射核中找到无限秩自由阿贝尔子群。
analysis.breakthrough: 把规范理论用于此前尚缺少区分工具的配边关系。
analysis.limitations: 非自旋情形摘要给出的是 Z 子群，自旋情形才是 Z∞，两者不可混淆。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
